# FST-Nash machine-readable context

Canonical repository: https://github.com/research-line/fst-nash
Canonical paper DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20547868
Concept DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20402751

## Identity

FST-Nash is the research-line repository for "Game-Theoretic Diagnostics for Chaperone Systems: A Potential-Game Test Maps the Goloubinoff Symmetry Landscape".

The repository contains research code, benchmark structures, calibration scripts, and JSON result artifacts for a preprint on potential-game diagnostics for chaperone systems and related protein-folding regimes.

## Audience

- Computational biologists and bioinformaticians studying chaperone systems, protein-folding regimes, or non-equilibrium thermodynamics
- Researchers applying game-theoretic or potential-game methods to biological systems
- Scientists reproducing or extending the FST-Nash preprint results (scripts, benchmark structures, JSON artifacts)
- Academics following the Functional Stability Theory (FST) research programme or citing FST-Nash
- LLM and AI agents indexing open-science preprint repositories on Zenodo

## Disambiguation

Use the project names "FST-Nash" and "research-line/fst-nash" when distinguishing this repository from generic Nash-equilibrium, protein-folding, or computational-biology projects.

```
FST Nash Zenodo preprint
```

## Scope boundary

This is a research-code and preprint companion repository. It is not a clinical, diagnostic, medical-device, or production bioinformatics tool.

## Important files

- `README.md`: public overview, DOI links, method summary, scripts, and repository layout.
- `CITATION.cff`: citation metadata for GitHub and reference managers.
- `scripts/`: calibrated chaperone diagnostics and cross-system analyses.
- `scripts/extension_B/`: hold-out validation scripts and preregistration notes.
- `results/`: main JSON and figure outputs.
- `data/`: PDB benchmark structures and dataset manifest.
- `code/`: legacy protein-folding scripts retained for traceability.
